## What each benchmark measures

- **plane_reproj_rmse_px** — marker reprojection RMSE across tilts and sensor noise (`gawaah.takhti`, lower_is_better)
- **placement_footprint_err_mm** — worse of the two measured edges vs the pasted truth (`gawaah.placement, gawaah.takhti`, lower_is_better)
- **sellevent_recall** — scripted OUT crossings the zone actually counted (`gawaah.sellevent, gawaah.takhti`, higher_is_better)
- **kernel_exactly_once** — rounds where racing threads produced exactly one debit (`gawaah.kernel, gawaah.ledger, gawaah.clock, gawaah.money`, higher_is_better)
- **ledger_verify_throughput** — from-genesis chain re-verification rate (`gawaah.ledger, gawaah.clock`, higher_is_better)

## Findings

Things the run said that nobody asked it. Each number is anchored to
`results/metrics.json` like every other number on this page.

- `MatLock.reproj_rmse_px` is an exact-fit residual, not a measurement. Across every locked frame in this sweep its standard deviation was `0.0000` <!--@ plane_reproj_rmse_px.detail.fit_residual_stdev_px --> px, because a homography fitted to four marker centres reproduces those same four centres by construction. The figure in the table above is instead the error of the marker CORNERS, which were held out of the fit; the untilted noiseless floor for that measurement is `0.1282` <!--@ plane_reproj_rmse_px.detail.baseline_untilted_noiseless_px --> px of renderer and detector rounding.
- Of the scripted sales this run staged, `1` <!--@ sellevent_recall.detail.misses_that_were_silent --> went uncounted WITHOUT the zone raising anything, against `1` <!--@ sellevent_recall.detail.misses_that_raised --> that did raise. The silent ones are objects lost by the tracker mid-crossing and re-acquired under a fresh id already past the line: the zone books that as a wrong-way arrival, which is benign by its own rules. The abstain-loudly invariant wants those raised, so this is a gap in the sell-event module and not in the benchmark.
- The kernel was raced by `24` <!--@ kernel_exactly_once.detail.threads_per_round --> threads per round over `6` <!--@ kernel_exactly_once.detail.rounds_total --> rounds and admitted `0` <!--@ kernel_exactly_once.detail.duplicate_intents --> duplicate intents and `0` <!--@ kernel_exactly_once.detail.extra_callers_admitted --> extra callers.

## Honest limits

- Every benchmark here runs against synthetic stimulus generated in
  `tools/bench.py`. They measure the code, not a shop counter. No claim
  on this page is a field measurement.
- `ledger_verify_throughput` is a wall-clock timing. It is excluded from
  the deterministic content hash and will differ between machines and
  between runs on the same machine.
- `sellevent_recall` deliberately includes events where the object is
  lost for longer than the tracker will hold it. Those are counted as
  misses. Some of them the module raises as exceptions and some it does
  not — see Findings above, and do not read a recall below one here as
  the abstention machinery working until that split is closed.
- A benchmark reported NOT BUILT has measured nothing at all. Its absence
  is not evidence of anything. Neither is a benchmark reported
  NOT_MEASURED: that one ran, and still has nothing to say.
- The two percentile columns are nearest-rank over the pooled samples of
  every seed. With a handful of samples per benchmark they are coarse,
  and on a benchmark that reports one sample per seed they are just
  order statistics of that short list. Read `worst`.
